title: Funerary Jar Form and Function

sources.title: Find Mystic Carrion's Servant
markers: After reading the {{SmRarityItem|Funerary Jar Form and Function}} book

summary: Read the slate to reveal the location of Mystic Carrion’s heart and unlock a dialogue option with Thrumbo.

fields.Quest use: Reading reveals Carrion’s heart is inside Thrumbo. Tell him to make him expel the heart, allowing you to destroy it for End Mystic Carrion’s Immortality or turn it in.
fields.Acquisition: Found in the Ancient Lair in the Undercity Ruins.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
